source.title: Superior Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
source.description:
Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of power?

Items offered to those revered amongst the Dawn are priced quite reasonably. I encourage you to make a purchase!
source.objective: For 7 Insignias of the Dawn and 7 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
source.progress: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.
source.completion: Good day, <name>. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
